records.title: Fast Unsupervised Brain Anomaly Detection and Segmentation with Diffusion Models
records.reason: Full text confirms a diffusion-model method for brain-image anomaly detection and segmentation. Its reported inference-time improvement is relative to autoregressive image models in medical imaging, not an LLM method or language inference optimization.

records.title: A Self-Attention Ansatz for Ab-initio Quantum Chemistry
records.reason: The self-attention ansatz targets ab-initio quantum chemistry calculations, not language-model inference.

records.title: ST-LLM: Large Language Models Are Effective Temporal Learners
records.reason: ST-LLM adapts language models for temporal learning tasks; its contribution concerns downstream temporal prediction capability, not inference cost or memory.

records.title: KVT: k-NN Attention for Boosting Vision Transformers
records.reason: The primary full text proposes k-nearest-neighbor attention for Vision Transformers to restrict dense image-patch attention and reduce noise/compute. Attention sparsification is conceptually adjacent to efficient LLM attention, but the technique and evaluations are specifically visual and do not establish language-model behavior or transfer. Keep borderline for lineage review.

records.title: OVO-Bench: How Far is Your Video-LLMs from Real-World Online Video Understanding?
records.reason: OVO-Bench is an evaluation benchmark for online video understanding by Video-LLMs; it measures task performance and does not propose an inference optimization.
